name: Deer Ridge Campground
note: Full-hookup campground (50/35/20-amp, filtered and softened water) on a wooded hillside off the highway near Wadena, about 50 sites in two loops, one around a small pond; bathhouse with laundry, wifi. $35 a night tax included, weekly and monthly rates; many seasonal sites. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: campdeerridge.com 2027 rates (AWH read 2026-10-02, behind a human check): one night $35 incl. tax, all sites full hookup, weekly $185, monthly $375, seasonal $1450; unrated on RV Life; Google 4.1 over 20 with phone (read 2026-10-02) - thin, kept on AWH's read
